brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at level 0 and level 1 present.

Built three notch drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch) which function as drawers, but automated test family:drawer counts 0 because configurator classifies them as family notch, not drawer. Functionally met, formally unmet by test.

requirements.requirement: Provides workbench storage (bins/trays for small parts)

finish.summary: Two-storey tower with three functional notch drawers and two storage bins; automated drawer test fails due to family classification (notch vs drawer) but build fulfills intent.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
